paragraphs: The use of the terms "Winnebago Industries," "Winnebago," "we," "our," and "us" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, unless the context otherwise requires, refer to Winnebago Industries, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiaries.
Winnebago Industries, Inc. is a leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products under the Winnebago, Grand

Design, Chris-Craft, Newmar and Barletta brands, which are used primarily in leisure travel and outdoor recreation activities. We also design and manufacture advanced battery solutions that deliver "house power," supporting internal electrical features and appliances for a variety of outdoor products including RVs, boats, specialty and other low-speed vehicles, as well as other industrial applications. Other products manufactured by us consist primarily of original equipment manufacturing parts for other manufacturers and commercial vehicles. We produce our towable RV units in Indiana; our motorhome RV units in Iowa and Indiana; our marine units in Indiana and Florida; and our battery solutions in Florida. We distribute our RV and marine products primarily through independent dealers throughout the U.S. and Canada, who then retail the products to the end consumer. We also distribute our marine products internationally through independent dealers, who then retail the products to the end consumer. Our battery solutions are primarily sold to customers in the U.S.

All references to Fiscal 2025 refer to the 52-week period ended August 30, 2025. Fiscal 2024 refers to the 53-week period ended August 31, 2024 and Fiscal 2023 refers to the 52-week period ended August 26, 2023.

Our internet website, located at www.winnebagoind.com, provides additional information about us. On our website you can obtain, free of charge, this and prior year Annual Reports on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K, and all other recent filings with the SEC. Our recent press releases and important information regarding our corporate governance practices are also available on our website. Information contained on our website is not incorporated into this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The SEC also maintains an internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC which can be accessed at http://www.sec.gov.
Our operations are organized into three reportable segments, Towable RV, Motorhome RV, and Marine, based on similarities within their markets, products, operations and distributions.

A towable RV is a non-motorized vehicle that is designed to be towed by automobiles, pickup trucks, SUVs, or vans and is used primarily as temporary living quarters during vacation and camping trips, or to support active and mobile lifestyles. The Recreation Vehicle Industry Association ("RVIA") classifies towable RVs into six types: conventional travel trailers, fifth wheels, travel trailers with expandable ends, folding camping trailers, truck campers, and park models. We manufacture and sell conventional travel trailers and fifth wheels under the Winnebago and Grand Design brand names, which are defined as follows:
Travel trailer Towed by means of a hitch attached to the frame of the vehicle Access, HIKE, Micro Minnie, Minnie, M-Series, Voyage, and Thrive Imagine, Momentum, Reflection, Serenova, and Transcend
Fifth wheel Constructed with a raised forward section that is connected to the vehicle with a special fifth wheel hitch N/A Influence, Momentum, Reflection, and Solitude

Our travel trailer and fifth wheel towable RVs are sold by dealers in the retail market with manufacturer's suggested retail prices ranging from approximately $20,000 to $163,000, which can vary depending on size and model, plus optional equipment and delivery charges.

Towable RV parts and service activities represent revenues generated by service work we perform for retail customers at our Elkhart, Indiana and Middlebury, Indiana facilities as well as revenues from the sale of unit parts. Our competitive strategy is to provide proprietary manufactured parts through our dealer network, which we believe increases customer satisfaction and the value of our towable RVs.

A motorhome RV is a self-propelled mobile dwelling used primarily as temporary living quarters during vacation and camping trips, or to support active and mobile lifestyles. The RVIA classifies motorhome RVs into three types, all of which we manufacture and sell under the Winnebago, Newmar, and Grand Design brand names, which are defined as follows:
Class A Built on a heavy truck chassis in both diesel and gas models with the ability to tow a small vehicle Adventurer, Forza, Sunstar, and Vista
Bay Star, Canyon Star, Dutch Star, Essex, King Aire, London Aire, Mountain Aire, New Aire, Northern Star, and Ventana

headings: Macroeconomic Risks
Our business may be sensitive to economic conditions, including those that impact consumer spending.
Credit market deterioration and volatility may restrict the ability of our dealers and retail customers to finance the purchase of our products.
Industry Risks
The industries in which we operate are highly competitive. Failure to compete effectively against competitors could negatively impact our business and operating results.
If we are unable to properly forecast future demand of our products, our operating results may be negatively impacted.
Our business is both cyclical and seasonal and is subject to fluctuations in sales and net income.
Our business depends on the performance of independent dealers.
An increase in dealer consolidation or the loss of a significant dealer could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Operational Risks
Our operations are primarily centered in northern Iowa and northern Indiana. Any disruption or delay at our primary manufacturing facilities could adversely affect our business and operating results.
Unanticipated changes to our dealer inventory levels could negatively impact our operating results.
Increases in raw material, commodity, and transportation costs and shortages of certain raw materials could negatively impact our business.
Failure to effectively manage strategic acquisitions and alliances, joint ventures, or partnerships could have a negative impact on our business.

Significant product repair and/or replacement costs due to product warranty claims and product recalls could have a material adverse impact on our results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.
Information Systems, Legal and Regulatory Risks
Our ESG commitments may impact our reputation, expose us to additional costs, or have other impacts which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations.
Financial Risks
An impairment in the carrying value of goodwill and trade names could negatively impact our consolidated results of operations.
The terms of our notes and other debt instruments could adversely affect our operating flexibility and pose risks of default.
General Risks
Our common stock trading price could decline if equity research analysts issue unfavorable commentary or downgrade our common stock.
paragraphs: Described below are certain risks that we believe apply to our business and the industries in which we operate. The following risk factors should be considered carefully in addition to the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The risks and uncertainties highlighted represent the most significant risk factors that we believe may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, liquidity or access to sources of financing, and, consequently, the market value of our common stock. The risks and uncertainties discussed in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are not exclusive and other risk factors that we may consider immaterial or do not anticipate may emerge as significant risks and uncertainties.

Companies within the RV and marine industries are subject to volatility in operating results due primarily to general economic conditions because the purchase of a RV or marine product is often viewed as a consumer discretionary purchase. Demand for discretionary goods in general can fluctuate with recessionary conditions, slow or negative economic growth rates, negative consumer confidence, reduced consumer spending levels resulting from tax increases or other factors, prolonged high unemployment rates, higher commodity and component costs, fuel prices, inflationary or deflationary pressures, reduced credit availability or unfavorable credit terms for dealers and end-user customers, higher short-term interest rates, and general economic and political conditions and expectations. Specific macroeconomic factors affecting the RV and marine industries include:
•Overall consumer confidence and the level of discretionary consumer spending; •Inflationary pressures affecting disposable consumer income;
•Interest rate fluctuations; •Employment trends; •Fuel prices;
•The adverse impact of global tensions on consumer spending and travel-related activities; and
•The adverse impact on margins due to increases in raw material costs, which we are unable to pass on to customers without negatively affecting sales.

paragraphs: Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") is intended to provide a reader of our financial statements with a narrative from the perspective of management on our financial condition, results of operations, liquidity, and certain other factors that may affect our future results. Unless otherwise noted, transactions and other factors significantly impacting our financial condition, results of operations and liquidity are discussed in order of magnitude. Our MD&A is presented in five sections:
•Overview •Results of Operations •Analysis of Financial Condition, Liquidity, and Capital Resources
•Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates •New Accounting Pronouncements
Our MD&A should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and related Notes included in Item 8 of Part II in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The year-over-year comparisons in this MD&A are as of and for the fiscal years ended August 30, 2025 and August 31, 2024, unless stated otherwise. The discussion of Fiscal 2023 results and related year-over-year comparisons as of and for the fiscal years ended August 31, 2024 and August 26, 2023 are found in Item 7 of Part II of our Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended August 31, 2024.
Winnebago Industries, Inc. is a leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products under the Winnebago, Grand

Design, Chris-Craft, Newmar and Barletta brands, which are used primarily in leisure travel and outdoor recreation activities. We also design and manufacture advanced battery solutions that deliver "house power," supporting internal electrical features and appliances for a variety of outdoor products including RVs, boats, specialty and other low-speed vehicles, as well as other industrial applications. Other products manufactured by us consist primarily of original equipment manufacturing parts for other manufacturers and commercial vehicles. We produce our motorhome RV units in Iowa and Indiana; our towable RV units in Indiana; our marine units in Indiana and Florida; and our battery solutions in Florida. We distribute our RV and marine products primarily through independent dealers across the U.S. and Canada, who then retail the products to the end consumer. We also distribute our marine products internationally through independent dealers, who then retail the products to the end consumer. Our battery solutions are primarily sold to customers in the U.S.

Our business continues to be challenged by macroeconomic conditions impacting retail consumers and our dealers, such as inflation, elevated interest rates, and lower consumer confidence. These factors have contributed to lower consumer spending and reduced short-term demand for large discretionary products such as RVs and marine products. In response, our dealers continue to exercise caution when managing stocking levels. In Fiscal 2025, these trends resulted in decreased sales due to declines in unit volume. While market pressures have been observed across our portfolio, they have been most acute in our Winnebago motorhome business. As part of our transformation of this business, we have recently taken significant steps to lower field inventory, improve working capital, align our production schedule to market demand, and accelerate stronger product value for our consumers in the future.
We expect that as consumer demand stabilizes, dealers will return to more stable ordering patterns across our portfolio of
businesses. We continue to produce and ship in accordance with dealer demand as evidenced and requested by dealer orders. In
addition, we are closely monitoring the potential impact of new or additional U.S. tariffs and retaliatory measures from other
countries, which may affect material costs or supply.
Despite the current economic uncertainty, we believe in the long-term health of consumer demand for RV and marine products.

In conjunction with the Grand Design RV entrance into the motorized RV category, we established a Grand Design motorhomes operating segment in the first quarter of Fiscal 2025. This newly created operating segment is included in the Motorhome RV reportable segment. Prior period amounts have not been reclassified as the impact was not significant.

paragraphs: 本年度報告表10-K中使用"Winnebago Industries"、"Winnebago"、"we"、"our"及"us"等詞彙，除非文意另有說明，否則均指Winnebago Industries, Inc.及其全部出資之子公司。
Winnebago Industries, Inc.為北美地區主要的戶外生活產品製造商，旗下品牌為Winnebago及Grand

Design, Chris-Craft, Newmar and Barletta 品牌，主要用於休閒旅遊與戶外休閒活動。我們也設計與製造先進電池解決方案，提供「居家電力」，支援各類戶外產品的內部電氣功能與家電，包括露營車、船隻、專業與其他低速車輛，以及其他工業應用。我們製造的其他產品主要為其他製造商與商用車的原廠零件。我們在印第安那州生產可拖式露營車單位；在愛荷華州與印第安那州生產動力露營車單位；在印第安那州與佛羅裏達州生產船隻單位；在佛羅裏達州生產電池解決方案。我們主要透過美國與加拿大境內的獨立經銷商銷售露營車與船隻產品，經銷商再零售給最終消費者。我們也透過獨立經銷商將船隻產品國際銷售，經銷商再零售給最終消費者。我們的電池解決方案主要銷售給美國的客戶。
所有提及財務年度 2025 的參考，均指 2025 年 8 月 30 日結訖的 52 週財務年度。財務年度 2024 指 2024 年 8 月 31 日結訖的 53 週財務年度，財務年度 2023 指 2023 年 8 月 26 日結訖的 52 週財務年度。

可拖行露營車為一種非動力車輛，設計為可由汽車、皮卡、SUV 或貨車拖行，主要用作假期與露營旅行時的臨時居所，或用以支援活躍與移動式的生活方式。美國露營車產業協會（RVIA）將可拖行露營車分為六種類型：傳統露營車、五分之一拖車（fifth wheels）、可擴展端露營車、可摺疊露營車、貨車露營車與休閒露營車。本公司製造並銷售傳統露營車與五分之一拖車，品牌為 Winnebago 與 Grand Design，其定義如下：
露營車 透過車輛框架上之拖鉤拖行 Access, HIKE, Micro Minnie, Minnie, M-Series, Voyage, 和 Thrive Imagine, Momentum, Reflection, Serenova, 和 Transcend
第五輪拖車結構為具有一個抬高的前段，並透過特殊的第五輪拖鉤與車輛連接 N/A 影響、動量、反思與孤獨
我們的露營拖車與第五輪拖車均透過經銷商在零售市場銷售，建議零售價格範圍約為 20,000 美元至 163,000 美元，視尺寸與型號而有所差異，另加選購配件與運送費用
可拖曳露營車的零組件與服務業務收入係指我們為零售客戶在印第安納州埃爾克哈特與米德伯裏設施所提供的服務工作收入，以及零組件銷售收入。我們的競爭策略為透過經銷網路提供專利製造的零組件，我們認為此舉可提升客戶滿意度與可拖曳露營車的價值

Class A 以重型卡車車架為基礎，提供柴油與汽油兩種模式，並具備拖曳小型車輛的能力 Adventurer、Forza、Sunstar 與 Vista

paragraphs: 管理階層對於財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析（"MD&A"）旨在為財務報表之閱覽者提供來自管理階層之敘述，說明本公司之財務狀況、營運成果、流動性及可能影響未來營運成果之其他因素。除非另有說明，影響本公司財務狀況、營運成果及流動性之交易及其他因素將依其影響程度順序說明。本公司之MD&A分為五個部分：
•概覽 •營運成果 •財務狀況、流動性及資本資源之分析
•關鍵會計政策與會計估計 •新會計準則宣佈
本公司之MD&A應與本年度10-K表報中第二部分第8項所載之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。
本說明書中的年對年比較係截至及針對2025年財務年度8月30日及2024年財務年度8月31日，除非另有說明。有關2023財務年度結果及相關年對年比較，截至及針對2024年財務年度8月31日及2023年財務年度8月26日之討論，請參閱我們2024年財務年度結業之Form 10-K第二部分第7項。

Winnebago Industries, Inc.為北美洲主要的戶外生活方式產品製造商，旗下品牌包括Winnebago、Grand Design、Chris-Craft、Newmar及Barletta，主要應用於休閒旅遊及戶外活動。我們亦設計及製造先進電池解決方案，提供「居家電力」，支援各類戶外產品之內部電氣功能及家電，包括露營車、船隻、專業及其它低速車輛，以及其它工業應用。我們所製造的其他產品主要為其他製造商及商用車輛之原廠零件。我們在愛荷華州及印第安納州製造我們的旅居車單位；在印第安納州製造我們的拖車單位；在印第安納州及佛羅裏達州製造我們的船隻單位；在佛羅裏達州製造我們的電池解決方案。我們主要透過美國及加拿大之獨立經銷商銷售我們的旅居車及船隻產品，經銷商再零售給最終消費者。我們亦透過獨立經銷商將船隻產品銷售至國際市場，經銷商再零售給最終消費者。我們的電池解決方案主要銷售至美國客戶。

我們的業務持續受到總體經濟條件影響，包括零售消費者及經銷商的壓力，例如通貨膨脹、高利率及較低的消費者信心。這些因素已導致消費者支出減少，以及大型非必需品如露營車及船隻產品的短期需求下降。為應對此情況，我們的經銷商在管理庫存量時持續保持謹慎。在2025財務年度，這些趨勢導致銷售減少，因單位數量下降。雖然我們產品組閤中觀察到市場壓力，但最為嚴重的是我們的Winnebago旅居車業務。作為我們轉型此業務的一部分，我們近期已採取重大措施降低現場存貨、改善營運資金、調整生產排程以符合市場需求，並加速未來為消費者提供更強大產品價值。

headings: 總體經濟風險
本公司業務可能受到經濟狀況的影響，包括影響消費者支出的情況。
信貸市場惡化及波動可能限制我們經銷商及零售客戶購買新產品的融資能力。
產業風險
我們所從事的產業具有高度競爭性。若無法有效與競爭對手競爭，可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生負面影響。
若我們無法正確預測產品未來需求，營運成果可能受到負面影響。
本公司業務同時具週期性及季節性，並受到銷售額及淨收入波動的影響。
本公司業務依賴獨立經銷商的表現。
經銷商集中度提高或失去重要經銷商，可能對本公司業務產生重大不利影響。
營運風險
本公司營運主要集中在愛荷華州北部與印第安那州北部。若主要製造設施發生中斷或延誤，可能對本公司業務與營運成果產生不利影響。
未預期的經銷商存貨水準變動，可能對本公司營運成果產生負面影響。
原材料、大宗商品及運輸成本上升，以及某些原材料短缺，可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
未能有效管理戰略收購與聯盟、合資企業或合作夥伴，可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
因產品保固聲請或產品回收所導致的重大產品維修及/或更換成本，可能對本公司營運成果、財務狀況及現金流產生重大不利影響。
資訊系統、法律及法規風險
本公司對環境、社會及治理（ESG）的承諾可能影響我們的聲譽，使我們面臨額外成本，或產生其他影響，這些影響可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
財務風險
goodwill 及商譽價值減損可能對我們的合併營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司發行的票據及其他債務工具的條款可能影響我們的營運彈性，並帶來違約風險。
一般風險
若資本市場研究分析師發表負面評論或將本公司普通股下修，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌。
paragraphs: 下列為我們認為適用於我們業務及所從事產業的某些風險。在審閱本年度10-K表報表所包含的其他資訊時，應同時謹慎考量以下風險因素。本年度10-K表報表中所強調的風險與不確定性，代表我們認為可能對我們業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、流動性或取得資金來源造成不利影響的最重要風險因素，進而影響我們普通股的市場價值。本年度10-K表報表中所討論的風險與不確定性並非唯一，我們可能認為某些風險因素不重要，或預期可能出現其他重要的風險與不確定性。

RV與船艇產業的公司會因總體經濟條件而導致營運結果波動，主要原因在於RV或船艇產品的購買通常被視為消費性支出。一般消費性商品的需求會因經濟衰退、經濟成長率減緩或為負值、消費者信心低迷、因稅收增加或其他因素導致消費支出減少、長期高失業率、原物料與零組件成本上升、燃料價格、通貨膨脹或通貨緊縮壓力、信貸取得困難或經銷商與最終用戶客戶的信貸條款不利、短期利率上升，以及總體經濟與政治條件及預期而有所變動。影響RV與船艇產業的特定總體經濟因素包括：
•總體消費者信心與消費性支出水準；•影響可支配消費者收入的通貨膨脹壓力；
•利率波動；•就業趨勢；•燃料價格；
•全球緊張局勢對消費者支出與旅遊相關活動的負面影響；以及
•因原物料成本上升導致毛利率受影響，而我們無法將此成本轉嫁給客戶而不影響銷售。
